title: Unix VFS sector size and device capability observers

scope.rationale: The two sqlite3_io_methods observers share lazy device-characteristic discovery and return the cached sector size or capability mask for the active Unix file owner.
excluded_responsibilities: QNX and platform-specific device probing outside the pinned profile

dependencies.caller_closure: Both assigned callbacks are installed in every active Unix sqlite3_io_methods table.

inputs: Open Unix sqlite3_file with native UnixFile owner
outputs: Cached positive sector size or device capability bit mask
contracts.ownership: Borrowed file owner; only lazy cache fields are mutated.
contracts.state_and_results: First access establishes the pinned-profile 4096-byte sector and powersafe-overwrite/immutable-compatible capability mask; subsequent access returns the cache.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No VFS I/O callback recursion or allocation. Discovery is local to the open file owner.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Pinned-profile discovery cannot fail; repeated calls are stable.

representation_differences: The pinned Linux profile uses explicit UnixFile cache fields and a typed shared initializer rather than source preprocessor branches.

oracle.protocol: Open ordinary, no-lock, dot-lock, and exclusive Unix files and call both io-method observers before and after file-control cache invalidation.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact integer values and stable repeated observations.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Pure file-owner cache observation; no direct I/O or crash boundary.
assurance.malformed_input: Only valid open sqlite3_file owners reach io-method callbacks.
assurance.continuation: Observation leaves all file operations available.
assurance.performance: Constant time after one local lazy initialization.

integration.native_call_path: Pager and public VFS consumers invoke these callbacks through the production Unix file method table.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Yes. All active Unix locking modes use the same source-shaped observers.

independent_review.notes: Pinned-C trace, assurance, and independent review remain open.
